interpretation: The conservative 3renhuku ticket probability is approximately calibrated on this burned new sample; there is no evidence here for a global downward probability shrink solely to repair calibration.
Buying every structurally selected ticket without regard to price loses about 15.1% ROI.
Therefore price is a necessary purchase-stage gate even when prediction remains odds-independent.
For core-range purchases, break-even decimal odds remain 1/p and a +10% EV margin remains 1.10/p; round upward for the owner-facing minimum-odds display.
This does not prove that the +10% margin is optimal or profitable prospectively. It preserves the existing owner-assisted V2 logic while new timestamped PRE odds evidence accumulates.
Longshot >20x promotion remains shadow-only pending its separate prospective evidence gate.
